content: Jana Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka.
Holiday Passover yuba kankadanda. Holiday Passover bama Jew-warra murumarin, mayi bread balan-balan nukanka, God buyay-maninka.

Jana maja-maja Godundumunku bayanka yalbaynka, jana teacher-teacher lawmunku, jana Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka. Yamba jana yinyilji bamanka, bama Jesusanka wawu-jirraymanya. Yinyaynka jana Jesus kiraynjaku yarkinkaku kuninka.
Judasangka Jesus mambarrinka.
Yala-yala nyulu Dubu Satan Judasandamunbu dukurrbu walan. Judas burri yindu Iscariot. Nyulu jakalbaku Jesusandamunbu jawun-karranda kunaman.
Yinyamun nyulu Judas maja-majanda priestanda, maja-majanda soldier-soldieranda dungan. Jana soldier-soldierangka Godumu bayan miyil-kujin. Judas jananda dungan, balkawan Jesus mambarrinka jananda.
Jana maja-maja wawurr-wawurrmanijin, yalaman, “Nganjin yunundu money dajilkuda.”
Yinyamun Judasangka good chance kujin, Jesus kiraynjaku mambarrinyamunku jananda maja-majanda.
Jesusangka Passover nukanka.
Yala-yala time kadanda holiday Passovermunbu. Jana minya sheep karrkay kuninka, nukanka.
Jesusangka bulanda Peteranda, Johnundu yalaman, “Yubal dungay, minya sheep, mayi ready-bunga, ngana wubulduku nukanka.”
Bula nyungundu babajin, “Wanjabu ngalin ready-bungal?”
Nyulu yalaman, “Yubal dungay townbu, yubal dingkar maku-nyajil, jungkalu banaji jarra-kulbal-kulbanya. Yubal nyungun wukurrika bayanba.
Yubal dingkaranda majanda bayanka balka, ‘Majangka Jesusangka babajin, “Room wanjabu ngayu, ngaykuwundu jawun-karrangka mayi Passover nukanka?” ’
Nyulu dingkarangka yubalan wangkar-wangkar roommunbu yalbaymba wundil tablebu, chairanga. Yinyaymba yubal minya, mayi ready-bunga.”
Bula dungan, wubulku warrmba-bungan yalaku Jesusangkaku yalaman. Yinyaymba bula mayi Passover ready-bungan.
Kuku Communionmunku.
Time kadanda mayi Passover nukanka, Jesus tablebu bundan jawun-karranji 12-balanji apostlesanji.
Nyulu jananda yalamanda, “Ngayu wawu jirray yanyu mayi Passover nukanka yurranji, ngayu warrngkanjiku.
Ngayu yurranda balkal, wawu nukanyamun ngayu mayi Passover kari nukal baja. Juma Godungku nyungu bama ngulkurrduku kujil. Yinyamun jana mumbarku binalmal yanyunku mayika. Yinyamun ngayu nukal baja.”
Yinyamun Jesusangka cup winemunji manin, God thankim-bungan, jananda yalaman, “Yanyu mana, dajiwaka.
Ngayu yurranda balkal, wawu nyikumun ngayu yalaku wine kari nukal baja. Juma Godungku nyungu bama ngulkurrduku kujil. Yinyamun ngayu nukal baja.”

Yinyamun Jesusangka bread manin, God thankim-bungan, mayi bread dumbarrin, jawun-karranda dajin. Nyulu yalaman, “Yanyu ngayku bangkarr, ngayu yurranka dajijin. Kaki yurra nukal, yurra milkabu wukurrika ngayu ngayku bangkarr yurranka dajijin.”

Wawu mayimun, nyulu jananda yalarrku cup winemunji dajin, yalaman, “Yanyu yira wine ngayku mula. Godungku promise dajin bamanda. Ngayku mula warri, yinya kuku manubajamalkuda. Ngayu mula dajiji yurranka.”
Yinyamun Jesusangka yalaman baja, “Yurra nyaka, nyubun yalaymba tablebu bundanday, nyulu nganya mambarril bamanda, jana nganya karrbanka.
Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Ngayu juma wulaykuda yala Godungku balkan. Yamba nyulu bamangka nganya mambarril, kuli jirray nyungundu kaday.”
Yinyamun jana jawun-karra jana-karrajiku balkawan, babajin, “Wanyangka nyungun mambarril?”
Jana murru-kangawan wanju majamanka.
Jana jawun-karrajiku murru-kangawan, babajin, “Wanju majamal?”

Jesusangka yinya kuku nyajin, nyulu yalaman, “Bama kanbal Jew-warra kari, jana Godunku binal kari. Jananga maja-maja junkurrji bamanka. Jana maja-majangka bama mambarril, jananin jawun bambanka. Yamba jana jawun kari, majakuda.
Yamba yurra yala kari. Kaki yurra majamanka bamanka, yurra yurraku bubanmaka. Maja nyuluku bubanmaka yala workingman, jarra warru bajakulu.

Wanju jarra yalbay, bama tablebu bundanday or bamangka nyungu mayi wundil? Yuwu, bama tablebu bunday, nyulu maja, yindu workingman. Ngayu kari kadan majamanka. Ngayu kadan workingmanmanka, bama helpim-bunganka.”
Jesusangka 12-balanda yalaman, “Yurra ngaykunji kadarin yiringkurrku. Kanbal ngaykunku wawu kari, nganya buyun-daman, yamba yurra nganya kari bawan.
Ngaykuwundu nganjanangka nganya maja-bungan. Ngayu yalarrku yurrangan maja-bungal.
Yala-yala ngayu ngayku bama ngulkurrduku kujil, yurra ngaykunji bundari, ngaykunji mayi nukal. Yala-yala yurra majamari Jew-warranka.”
Jesusangka balkan Peterangka nyungun juma darrbil.

Jesusangka Simon Peteranda yalaman, “Simon, yundu nyakada. Dubungku Satanangka Godundu babajin yurranka jawun-karranka. Nyulu yurranin milka-bakanka buyunmanka. Nyulu yurrangan ngami-ngami-bunganka ngaykundumun, yala muyarabu diburr ngami-ngami-bungal rubbishmun.

Yamba ngayu Godunji balkawan, babajin yununin junkurrji-bunganka buyun-buyunku. Ngayu nyungundu babajin yundu ngaykuwunbu kukungu milka-jananka. Yundu juma nganya bawal, nganya darrbil. Yamba yundu jurrkiji baja, ngaykunku wawu-jirraymal baja. Yinyamun yundu junkurrjimal, yundu ngayku bama yindu-yindu junkurrji-bunga buyun-buyunku.”
Peterangka yalaman, “Maja, jana nganya nguba jailba mumbal, nganya nguba yarkinkaku kunil, yamba ngayu yunun kari bawal, kari bajaku darrbil.”
Jesusangka Peteranda yalaman, “Milkanga kuji yanyu kuku ngayku. Jukijuki yirrkanjiku, yundu 3 times balkal, yundu ngaykunku binal kari.”
Kuku kurmunku, naybuku.

Jesusangka jawun-karranda yalaman, “Ngadiku ngayu yurrangan yungan bamanji bundanka. Yurra money ngunyinda kari wundin, kurmun kari wundin, dambal yindu kari wundin.” Nyulu jananda babajin, “Yala-yala yurra dungarin, yurra dakwuyku dungarin? Bamangka yurranji dajiwan? Yurranin yulmbarrin or kari?” Jawun-karrangka yalaman, “Jana nganjinan yulmbarrin, nganjinanji dajiwankuda, nganjin kari dakwuyku dungarin.”

Jesusangka yalaman, “Nyiku walu-yinduda. Bamangka juma yurranga kari dajil baja. Yurra money ngunyinda wundida. Yalarrku yurra naybu sword wundi. Kaki yurra naybu kari, yurra kambi sellim-bunga, naybu buy-im-bunganka.
Ngadiku prophetangka Godumu kuku kabanba balkan ngaykunku. Nyulu balkan,

content.text: ‘Bamangka nyungun jailba mumbanka, balu nyulu buyun bajaku.’

content: Yinya kuku ngaykunku must manubajamaka.”
Jawun-karrangka yalamanda, “Nyaka, Maja, naybu sword jambul yaluy.” Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Kari, bawa. Ngayu storybuku balkan, yurranin binal-bunganka.”
Jesus Godunji balkawan.
Jana Jesusangka town bawan, wuburrbu Olivesmunbu dungarin. Jana yarbarrka yinyaymba dungarin.
Jana kadarin, Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Miyil-janay, praymaka, yurra kari milka-jananka Dubundu.”
Yinyamun nyulu jananin bawan, buban dungan, bungkubu janan, praymanijin.
Nyulu yalaman, “Nganjan, ngayu wawu kari wulanka. Yamba yunduku nganya balkan wulanka bamanka wubulkuku. Ngayu wulayda jananka, yala yunduku wawubu.”
Nyubun angel jirimun nguwimal milbijin, nyungun junkurrji-bunganda.
Nyulu milka-bujarku prayman, yaykarrku prayman. Jila warrin nyungundumun yala mula, bubungu daran.
Wawu praymun, nyulu jawun-karrandaku dungan baja. Jana milka-bujar, baja-burray, yinyaynka jana warngku wunanarin.
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Yurra wanyurrinku warngku wunanay? Wandi, praymaka, yurra kari milka-jananka Dubundu.”
Jana Jesus karrban.

Jesus balkan-balkawaynku, bama wubul kadarin. Judasangka jananin juru-kulban. Nyulu jakalbaku Jesusamu jawun. Nyulu Jesusanda kadan, nyungun kissim-bunganka. Judasangka jananda jakalbaku balkan, “Ngayu dingkar kissim-bungal, milbinka yinyakudabi Jesus. Nyungun karrbada.”
Jesusangka Judasanda yalaman, “Judas, ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Yala yundu kissmundu nganya mambarril jananda?”
Jana jawun-karrangka Jesusandamundu yinya nyajin, jana nyungundu babajin, “Maja, yundu wawu nganjin jananji naybubu kuniwanka?”
Yinyamun nyubunyinja jawunyungku bamanga slaveamu milka yakan naybubu swordmundu. Nyulu slave majamu yalbaymu Godundumunku bayanka.
Yamba Jesusangka yalaman, “Kari bajaku. Yala kari!” Yinyamun nyulu slaveamu milka karrban, ngulkurr-bungan baja.

Bama wubul bajaku yinyay. Kanbal maja-maja jirray Godundumunku bayanka, kanbal soldier-soldier Godundumunku bayanka, kanbal elder-elder Godundumunku bayanka. Jana wubulku kadarin, Jesus karrbanka. Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Yurra wanyurrinku naybujiku, jukujiku ngaykundu kadarin, nganya karrbanka?

Ngayu wurrmay-baka kari. Yurra nganya every day nyajin Godundumunbu bayanba, bama binal-bungal-bunganya, yamba yurra nganya kari karrban. Yurra nganya nguwul-nguwulbu karrbankada, Dubungku yurrangan milka-bakanya. Nyulu Dubu maja jirray nguwul-nguwulku.”
Peterangka Jesus darrbin.
Jana Jesus karrban, nyungun bayanba wundin. Bayan majamu yalbayamu Godundumunku bayanka. Peterangka jananin wukurrin kala-kalbaymundu.
Nyulu fencemunbu walan majandamunbu bayanba, baya nyajin wayjun-wayjujinya dindarra yardba. Kanbal bama bayanga bundandarin. Nyulu dungan, jananda kunaman.
Nyubunyinja jalbungku Peter nyajin bundandanya. Yinya jalbu workmanijin majanka jirraynka. Nyulu jalbungku Peter biku-nyajin, yalaman, “Yanyu dingkar yalarrku Jesusanji bundandan.”
Yamba Peterangka darrbin, jalbundu yalaman, “Jalbu, ngayu nyungunku binal kari.”
Juma nyubunyinja dingkarangka yalarrku Peter nyajin, yalaman, “Yundu Jesusamu jawun.” Yamba Peterangka yalaman baja, “Kari, ngayu janandamun kari.”
Juma yinduynju bamangka Peteranda yalaman, “Yundu Jesusanjikuda dungan-dungan. Yundu Galilee-warramu kuku balkan-balkaway.”
Peterangka yalaman, “Kari bajaku. Yundu wadu-wadukuda.” Peter balkan-balkawaynku, jukijuki yirrkaynda.

Nyulu Maja Jesus jurrkijin, Peter junkayku nyajin. Jinbalku Peteranda milkanga kadan kuku Jesusangka balkan nyungundu. Jesusangka jakalbaku Peteranda yalaman, “Jukijuki yirrkanjiku, yundu nganya 3 times darrbil.”
Peter ngalkalba dungan, milka-bujarku badinda.
Jana Jesus yajarrin, jururr-jururr kunin.
Kanbalda soldier-soldierngka Jesus miyil-kujin. Jana nyungun yajarrin, jukubu kunin.
Jana nyungun miyil nandan, babajin, “Wanjungku yunun kunin, nganjinanda balka.”
Yinyamundu jana nyungundu kuku buyun balkan baja, balkan baja.
Jana Jesus jajirrin jakalba Councilanda.

Wungar dakan, jana bama elder-elder, maja-maja jirray Godundumunku bayanka, teacher-teacher lawmunku, jana wubulku murumarin council meetingmunku. Soldier-soldierangka Jesus jakalba Councilanda wundin.
Jana Jesusanda babajin, “Yundu bama Godundumun? Yundu Godumu Christ? Nganjinanda balka.” Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Kaki ngayu yurranda balkal, yurra ngaykuwunbu kukungu kari milka-janay.
Kaki ngayu yurranda kuku babaji, yurra nganya kari answerim-bungal.
Kari. Wawu nyikumun yurra nganya nyajil bundandanya Godunji. Ngalin junkurr-muruku bunday. Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba.”
Jana nyungundu babajin baja, “Yundu Godumu kangkal or kari?” Jesusangka yalaman, “Ngayukuda.”
Jana jana-karrajiku balkawan, “Bama yindu kari wundi baja, nyungun nyuyanka. Ngana nyungun nyajin yalamanya, ‘Ngayu Godkuda.’”
